messages:
alexa: kicking off a small RFC follow-up: proposal for a 'micro-onboard' gate between ingest and mini-bench. goal: catch tokenizer/serialization + obvious decode mismatches in <5s.
hiro: +1. keep it opt-in for alpha. main constraints: minimal GPU cycles and clear hard vs soft semantics.
chloe: checks i want: token-count-stability, detokenize roundtrip, seed-determinism (temp=0), and a p95 perf smoke. also 6 unicode edgecases.
ben: hard vs soft: hard = token-count mismatch for same unicode codepoints OR detokenize failure. soft = output delta above tiny threshold. soft should create an auto-triage with diffs.
alexa: agree. plan to store a compact fingerprint in model manifest: vocab_sha256, special_tokens_v, quant_label. runner can short-circuit when fingerprint matches approved variants.
hiro: quant_label is important. quantized layouts (q4, int8-ptq) decode differently; include bits+layout.
chloe: sample manifest snippet:
```
micro_onboard:
  enabled: true
  samples: 10
  seq_len: 24
  seed: 101
  timeout_ms: 3500
  fingerprint: {vocab_sha256: "...", specials_v: "v3", quant_label: "int8-ptq"}
```
ben: runner defaults: concurrency=6, max_runtime=4s, metric= micro_onboard_flake_rate. add a Console badge: micro-onboard:pass | review | blocked.
norm: ops: if blocked pre-deploy -> cancel rollout. post-deploy -> alert + manual rollback guideline. also require re-run button in Console.
onboard-bot: micro-onboard queued for model redwood/cedar-mini at 5012345682.
onboard-bot: micro-onboard result: redwood/cedar-mini -> status=review, token_count_ok=true, roundtrip=false, det_confidence=low, p95=12ms. golden_check=skipped.
alexa: okay will draft RFC patch with staged acceptance matrix: preflight -> micro-onboard -> mini-bench -> full-bench. pinging infra/runtime/docs for quick reviews.
hiro: i'll add fingerprint migration script and runner enforcement for canonical decode args.
chloe: i'll prepare the adversarial unicode list and doc text about soft-fail semantics.
ben: timeline: alpha opt-in in 2 sprints, then evaluate metrics for default-on in 8 weeks.
alexa: thanks — will post RFC link once ready and tag reviewers.
